summary:
Okafor CRC 2026 worklist (RBC-QM-02), 5 members:

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0001), patient messaged (comm-t0005) | No qualifying screening on record. Her frailty entry (cond-00189) was marked entered in error on 10/23 (Dr. Lin, comm-00301), so the frailty + advanced illness exclusion no longer applies, even with donepezil. No hospice, palliative care or nursing-home record. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice episode eoc-00002 was active 06/16 to 08/21/2026 (now finished; confirmed by St. Brigid discharge summary doc-00402). No order or contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0002), patient messaged (comm-t0006) | Her FIT obs-01732 was corrected on 10/23: collection date 12/31/2025, not 01/05/2026, so it falls outside 2026. No other screening. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0003), patient messaged (comm-t0007) | Her 06/2024 sDNA-FIT obs-01871 is now entered in error: the specimen belonged to another patient (lab notice doc-00401). The 2025 colonoscopy order sr-00003 was never done, and an order is not screening. |
| pt-0073 Marisol Quintero (58) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0004), patient messaged (comm-t0008) | The 01/08/2026 FIT obs-73001 was cancelled and re-issued as obs-05001 with collection date 12/28/2025, outside 2026 (doc-00403). No other screening. |

All FIT order windows run 10/23 to 12/31/2026, and none of these patients already had a FIT order. A review note is in each chart (doc-t0009 to t0013). The five inbox items that arrived during the work (inbox-a0001 to a0005) were reviewed, acted on and completed. Two of them changed my first assessments (pt-0022 and pt-0024 had looked up to date), and two changed reasons (pt-0009 had looked excluded, pt-0073 confirmed as an open gap). Nothing else was waiting at the end. Not done: pt-0024's open 2025 colonoscopy order sr-00003 was left for Dr. Okafor to review.
